drafts.title: FDA 510(k): Female Culture Device; Male Culture Device; Transfer Device; Access Device
drafts.why: Direct FDA 510(k) clearance for clinical chemistry diagnostic device
drafts.summary: FDA 510(k) clearance granted to Zhejiang Kindly Medical Device Co., Ltd. for a set of devices including a Female Culture Device, Male Culture Device, Transfer Device, and Access Device, under the Clinical Chemistry panel. Clearance number K252899.
drafts.draft:
A 510(k) just cleared for a female culture device, male culture device, transfer device, and access device (all one submission, K252899). Applicant is Zhejiang Kindly Medical Device Co., Ltd., cleared under the Clinical Chemistry panel.

I mostly notice these when they're adjacent to something I'm working on. This one caught my eye because the device grouping is a little unusual to see bundled together in a single clearance. Could be nothing, could be worth a closer read of the predicate.
